content: {"question":"If an employee moves from GitLab Pty Ltd in Australia to GitLab Canada Corp, what are the main differences in the enrollment process for medical coverage between the two locations?","answer":"In Australia, employees must use the BUPA portal, complete six registration questions, and then select coverage before submitting a BUPA application, whereas in Canada employees choose a coverage level, email the decision to total‑rewards@gitlab.com, and then complete a Manulife registration after receiving an invitation.","evidence_a":"1. Visit the [GitLab BUPA employer portal](https://www.bupa.com.au/corporate/gitlab) 2. Click \"Get a quote\" and complete 6 registration questions 3. Review your options, plan summaries, and monthly rates 4. Select your preferred coverage and click \"join now\" 5. Complete BUPA's application with contact, Medicare, and payment details","evidence_b":"1. Choose coverage level (individual or family) 2. Email decision to total-rewards@gitlab.com 3. Complete ManuLife registration when invitation arrives"}
